description: The file contains Python source code implementing functions for managing environment variable mappings between a common format and framework-specific formats based on YAML templates. It includes functions for retrieving template paths, parsing templates, applying prefixes, and converting environment variables between representations, with support for multiple frameworks.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Returns the Path object for the environment template file of the specified framework, based on the current file's directory.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML template file, extracting an optional prefix and a mapping dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Applies a given prefix to all environment variable keys in a dictionary, returning a new dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Maps environment variables from common format to framework-specific format using a template's mapping and prefix.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts framework-specific environment variables to the common format, considering direct mappings and prefixes.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Lists all frameworks available based on the presence of 'env.template' files in sibling directories.
